<description>
This PR marks the `bitcoin-build-config.h` header with the dedicated [`IWYU pragma: always_keep`](https://github.com/include-what-you-use/include-what-you-use/blob/master/docs/IWYUPragmas.md#iwyu-pragma-always_keep), which makes the per-include `IWYU pragma: keep` comments redundant.

As a result, grepping for `IWYU pragma: keep` returns only the genuine use cases, each of which should be properly documented.
</description>

<commits>
cc37763829 scripted-diff: Drop `IWYU pragma: keep` from build config includes

The `bitcoin-build-config.h` header is now marked with
`IWYU pragma: always_keep`, which makes the per-include
`IWYU pragma: keep` comments redundant.

-BEGIN VERIFY SCRIPT-
OLD='#include <bitcoin-build-config.h> // IWYU pragma: keep'
NEW='#include <bitcoin-build-config.h>'
sed -i "s|$OLD|$NEW|" $(git grep -l "$OLD")

GUARD='#ifndef BITCOIN_CONFIG_H'
PRAGMA='// IWYU pragma: always_keep'
sed -i "s|^$GUARD$|$PRAGMA\n\n&|" cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in

STALE='^Make sure to include it with the IWYU pragma'
sed -i "/$STALE/,+2d" test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_cpp.rs
-END VERIFY SCRIPT-
</commits>
